title: K Similar Strings
description: Find the minimum number of swaps to make string A equal to string B.
pseudocode:
1. queue = [[s1, 0]]
2. visited = {s1}
3. while queue:
4.   curr, depth = queue.shift()
5.   if curr == target: return depth
6.   i = first mismatch index
7.   for j = i + 1 to n:
8.     if curr[j] == target[i] and curr[j] != target[j]:
9.       swap(curr, i, j)
10.      if curr not in visited: queue.push([curr, depth + 1])

steps.note: Initialize BFS queue with starting string 'abac' and depth 0
Swap index 0 and 1 to match target 'baac'
New state 'baac' added to queue with depth 1
